 Match Predictions: YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 - Dolphins vs Boland - Lions vs Titans - November 1st
 Match Predictions: YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 ©CWM 
 By Cricket World Staff 
 Saturday 31 October 2026 
 CSA Pro T20 Cup 
 T20 series Schedule Super 8 T20, Durban Live Dolphins 174/4 20 ov Boland 164/3 19 ov BOL need 11 runs in 6 remaining balls
 Boland elected to bowl
 Live scores and commentary 
 Super 8 T20, Johannesburg Sun 1 Nov Lions Titans Sun 1 Nov, 12:30 GMT 
 Predictions and form stats 
 Here are the Predictions for YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026, 61st Match (Super 8) - Dolphins vs Boland and 62nd Match (Super 8) - Lions vs Titans, to be played on the 1st of November at the Kingsmead, Durban and The Wanderers Stadium, Johannesburg.
 Match Prediction - Dolphins v Rocks 
 61st Match (Super 8) - Dolphins vs Boland (Kingsmead, Durban) 
 Ground Stat:
 Average 1st Innings Total at Kingsmead, Durban (CSA T20 Challenge) - 153 
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Kingsmead, Durban (CSA T20 Challenge) - 137 
 Current Form Dolphins:
 Dolphins are currently placed at the 1st position on Group A points table with 5 wins and 2 losses to their credit. They have 25 points to their name.
 The top run scorer for Dolphins in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Jason Smith with 211 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Dolphins in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Prenelan Subrayen with 10 scalps under his belt.
 Dolphins have won their previous match against South Western Districts comfortably by 10 wickets.
 The match was reduced to 8 overs per side due to rain.
 South Western Districts batted first and they posted a total of 51 for 4 in 8 overs. Yaseen Vallie and Janneman Malan were quite slow off the blocks. They consumed way too many deliveries without making an impact. It cost the team dearly. Andile Phehlukwayo scored a few quick runs towards the back end to help South Western Districts get to a total of 51 in 8 overs of play.
 During the chase, Dolphins' openers Bryce Parsons and Grant Roelofsen looked in a hurry to finish the game. Parsons made 32 off 13 balls while Grant scored 17 runs in 10 deliveries to help Dolphins get over the line in the 4th over itself with all 10 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Boland:
 Boland are currently placed at the 2nd position on Group B points table with 6 wins and 1 loss to their credit. They have 26 points to their name.
 The top run scorer for Boland in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Gavin Kaplan with 234 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Boland in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Imran Manack with 10 scalps under his belt.
 Boland have won their previous match against Titans in a Super Over.
 Titans batted first and they posted a total of 137 for 8 in 20 overs. The man in form Lhuan-dre Pretorius got out cheaply. Dewald Brevis and Lethabo Phahlamohlaka also disappointed and threw it away too soon. Rivaldo Moonsamy and Dayyaan Galiem tried to revive the innings with knocks of 26 and 31 runs respectively. Donovan Ferreira and Eathan Bosch scored some quick runs towards the back end and Titans managed to get past the 130 run mark, finishing at 137 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Boland lost the key wickets of Blayde Capell and Gavin Kaplan quite early into the innings. After their dismissals, Lehan Botha played really well. He took the responsibility of taking Boland over the line, despite wickets falling in regular succession at the other end. The match went right down to the wire. Boland needed only 3 runs to win in the last over. Eathan Bosch then stepped up and bowled a fantastic last over, giving away only 2 runs. Lehan Botha stayed not out at 52 but failed to take Boland home and the match ended in a tie.
 Titans batted first in the Super Over and scored only 4 runs and lost both their wickets. Boland comfortably chased it down and won the game.

 Match Prediction - Lions v Titans (SA) 
 62nd Match (Super 8) - Lions vs Titans (The Wanderers Stadium, Johannesburg) 
 Ground Stat:
 Average 1st Innings Total at The Wanderers Stadium, Johannesburg (CSA T20 Challenge) - 170 
 Average 2nd Innings Total at The Wanderers Stadium, Johannesburg (CSA T20 Challenge) - 147 
 Current Form Lions:
 Lions are currently placed at the 2nd position on Group A points table with 5 wins, 1 loss and 1 no result match to their credit. They have 25 points to their name.
 The top run scorer for Lions in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Zubayr Hamza with 215 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Lions in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Codi Yusuf with 8 scalps under his belt.
 Lions have won their previous match against Eastern Storm by 9 wickets.
 Eastern Storm batted first and they posted a huge total of 198 for 6 in 20 overs. Kabelo Sekhukhune and Ronan Hermann got their team off to a flying start. Kabelo made 45 off 25 balls while Hermann scored 62 runs in only 38 deliveries, collecting 7 fours and 3 sixes. Christopher Britz and Dewan Marais also contributed quite well and helped Eastern Storm get to a highly competitive total of 198 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Zubayr Hamza and Neil Trimmers were sensational with the bat. Hamza made 45 runs while Trimmers went on to score 107 runs off 55 balls. Rassie van der Dussen also looked at his vintage best, scoring 46 off 27 deliveries as Lions managed to get over the line in the 18th over itself with 9 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Titans:
 Titans are currently placed at the 1st position on Group B points table with 6 wins and 1 loss to their credit. They have 28 points to their name.
 The top run scorer for Titans in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Lhuan-dre Pretorius with 380 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Titans in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Tabraiz Shamsi with 10 scalps under his belt.
 Titans have lost their previous match against South Western Districts by 3 wickets.
 Titans batted first and they posted a total of 157 for 5 in 20 overs. Lethabo Phahlamohlaka and Dewald Brevis got out cheaply and Titans looked out of place in the Powerplay despite Lhuan-dre Pretorius' quickfire 45. The middle order including Rivaldo Moonsamy and Donovan Ferreira batted quite slow and it didn't help the matters at all. Dayyaan Galiem and Duan Jansen played well. Galiem made 33 while Jansen scored 27 runs as Titans managed to reach 157 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, South Western Districts started off very well with openers Janneman Malan and Yaseen Vallie adding 74 runs for the 2nd wicket taker. Vallie made 28 while Malan scored 43 runs. Modise Maloka also played to his potential. He smashed 47 runs in just 27 balls, stayed not out and helped South Western Districts get over the line in the 19th over with 3 wickets in hand.
